sections.heading: What is Economics?
sections.text: Economics studies how people use limited resources to meet unlimited wants.

sections.heading: Scarcity
sections.text: Resources are limited, so choices must be made.

sections.heading: Supply and Demand
sections.text:
Supply is availability; demand is willingness to buy.
Prices change based on both.

sections.heading: Inflation
sections.text: Increase in prices over time reduces purchasing power.

sections.heading: Opportunity Cost
sections.text: The value of the next best alternative you give up.

sections.heading: Impact on Finance
sections.text: Affects jobs, prices, savings, and investment decisions.
